headline: Apple Pencil to get replaceable batteries by 2027
summary: New Apple Pencil models coming in 2027 with improved repairability
details: Apple is reportedly planning to release two new Apple Pencil models in the first half of 2027. The upcoming designs are expected to feature improved repairability, thanks to upcoming EU regulations calling for more easily replaceable batteries within consumer electronics.

The new Apple Pencil models, codenamed B582 and B632, will update the entry-level Apple Pencil and Apple Pencil Pro, respectively. The existing Apple Pencil Pro introduced a new sensor that can sense a user squeezing on the barrel.

The move towards more repairable devices would be a welcome change for Apple customers, as iFixit has deemed all Apple Pencil models 'repairability fails' due to the inability to replace the internal batteries after they die.
caption:
Will the new Apple Pencil be more eco-friendly? EU regulations are pushing for change

Apple is reportedly planning to release two new Apple Pencil models in the first half of 2027. The upcoming designs are expected to feature improved repairability, thanks to upcoming EU regulations calling for more easily replaceable batteries within consumer electronics.

The new Apple Pencil models, codenamed B582 and B632, will update the entry-level Apple Pencil and Apple Pencil Pro, respectively. The existing Apple Pencil Pro introduced a new sensor that can sense a user squeezing on the barrel.

The move towards more repairable devices would be a welcome change for Apple customers, as iFixit has deemed all Apple Pencil models 'repairability fails' due to the inability to replace the internal batteries after they die.
